correctness.rationale: The uniform-source expectation is sum of squared retained component sizes divided by N, equivalent to one plus two/N times all-pairs connection probabilities. For a tree plus one new edge, two disjoint arcs on the induced cycle yield gain (2/N) sum W_i W_j p^(d+1-j+i)(1-p^(j-i)). The five symmetry types A-E exhaust all nonedges, and algebraic comparisons eliminate same-class chords and the less favorable hub shortcut. The remaining difference is p^2(1-p)H_(a,b). In the cubic Bernstein basis H has exactly one coefficient sign variation, so Descartes after t=p/(1-p) and H(0)<0<H(1) give a unique simple zero. Independent exact bond-subgraph enumeration of all nonedges for 1<=b<=a<=3 at p=1/8,1/2,7/8 verified 18 cases.
